images.caption: Figure 2:Overview of Qwen-Audio-3.1-ASR and its capabilities.The model family supports multilingual and dialectal speech recognition, user-selectable dialect transcription or translation into Chinese, long-audio context and domain entity recognition, hierarchical hotword customization, and native transcription polishing. Speaker-diarized ASR produces transcripts with speaker labels and timestamps, including overlapping speech, while general audio understanding supports captioning, temporal grounding, sound event detection, and audio question answering. Streaming recognition provides incremental transcripts for real-time display, followed by a non-streaming refresh at the utterance end. Capability availability depends on the model variant; streaming does not support speaker diarization or general audio understanding.
Figure 3:Overview of the instruction-controlled decoding workflow of Qwen-Audio-3.1-ASR.

Figure 7:The FunVerl asynchronous RL framework. Audio preprocessing and vLLM rollout generation produce candidate responses, task-specific rewards score the responses, and the Megatron trainer updates the policy using GRPO. A trajectory queue decouples generation from optimization, and updated policy weights are synchronized to the rollout engine.

Figure 8:Overview of multi-teacher on-policy distillation in FunVerl.
Student-generated responses are scored by task-routed teachers and
the student using the same input and response prefixes.
Thek3k_{3}objective provides token-level distillation supervision,
while NCCL weight synchronization refreshes the rollout policy
after student updates.

Figure 9:Overview of the Message ASR workflow used in Qwen-Audio-3.1-ASR, following the design of Qwen-Audio-3.0-ASR. Streaming audio is decoded incrementally to provide responsive partial transcripts. Historical context supplies entity and topic cues, native polishing improves readability within the same decoding pass, and configurable right context balances streaming latency and recognition accuracy. At utterance end, the model refreshes the displayed hypothesis using the complete available context.
